title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2606.03303v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong informal mathematical reasoning but struggle to generate mechanically verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean. We present LEAP, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving. LEAP leverages foundation model capabilities, such as informal reasoning, instruction following, and iterative self-refinement. By decomposing complex problems into smaller units, the system bridges formal proof construction with informal blueprints through continuous interaction with the Lean compiler. To provide a rigorous evaluation beyond increasingly saturated benchmarks, we introduce Lean-IMO-Bench, a benchmark of IMO-style problems formalized in Lean, with short statements yet highly non-routine and multi-step proofs across a wide range of difficulty levels. Empirically, on the latest 2025 Putnam Competition

translated_title: LEAP：利用智能体框架增强大语言模型的形式化数学能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的非形式化数学推理能力，但在生成如Lean等形式化语言中可机械验证的证明方面仍存在困难。我们提出了LEAP，这是一个智能体框架，使通用基础模型能够在自动化形式化定理证明方面达到最先进的性能。LEAP充分利用了基础模型的能力，如非形式化推理、指令遵循和迭代自我完善。通过将复杂问题分解为更小的单元，该系统通过与Lean编译器的持续交互，将形式化证明构建与非形式化推理蓝图连接起来。为了提供超越日益饱和的基准测试的严格评估，我们引入了Lean-IMO-Bench，这是一个包含以Lean形式化的国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）风格问题的基准测试，这些问题陈述简短，但需要高度非常规的多步骤证明，涵盖广泛的难度级别。实证结果表明，在最新的2025年普特南竞赛上……
tldr: 该论文提出LEAP智能体框架，通过问题分解、非形式化推理蓝图与Lean编译器的持续交互，使通用大语言模型在自动形式化定理证明上达到最先进水平，并发布了包含IMO风格难题的Lean-IMO-Bench基准用于严格评估。
